verdict.rationale: YYLO's own integrations script brings Slack messages or GitHub issues into its kanban and returns completed responses to the source thread, so a chat thread can be used to hand off a task. The docs do not say an agent can be @-tagged in a thread, and they show no conversational back-and-forth. missing for 10: documented @-mention/tagging of an agent in a chat thread, interactive discussion within the thread (beyond returning a completed response), setup/configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task

citations.quote: Bring Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban and return completed responses to their source thread.
Delegate bounded work across agents and models.
